**Foundation Version Release Notes**

**Foundation PRDs \- Version 2.0 Release Notes**

This release marks the transition of the Foundation PRD set from v1.1 (first internal draft) to v2.0 (EPD build baseline). Version 2.0 incorporates all decisions reached during the structured tech team review cycle. The documents are now locked as the authoritative source for build. No open questions from the v1.1 review cycle remain unresolved \- except the SLA commitment for verification timelines, which requires a business operations decision.

# **What Changed Across All Documents**

* **Freelancer removed from scope.** APEX serves businesses only. All Freelance Certificate paths, form fields, and document logic removed across every PRD.

* **Terminology overhauled.** 'Counterparty' is replaced throughout. PRD 2 is now Trading Partner Management. The entity model distinguishes Business (canonical) from Trading Partner Record (relational). Full replacement table in Document 0 Section 2\.

* **Section-level CTA model introduced.** Tier unlocks no longer happen automatically when all fields are approved. Admin must click an explicit section CTA after all section fields are approved. Each section has its own CTA and its own correction path.

* **TIN and VAT Registration Number separated everywhere.** TIN is 10 digits. VAT Registration Number is 15 digits starting and ending with 3\. Two distinct fields across all forms, admin review matrices, and data models.

# **Document 0 \- Business Logic Decisions Record**

## **New Sections**

* **Section 2 \- Data Model & Terminology Definitions.** Canonical definitions for Business, Trading Partner Record, Business Network, Business Directory, and Badge. Three-state Business registration model (Not Registered, Registered-Pending, Platform Verified). Full terminology replacement table.

* **Section 8 \- Merge Behavior & Record Consolidation.** Six merge decisions locked: trigger scope, identifier hierarchy, full overwrite rules, alias preservation at merge, duplicate handling, transaction re-pointing, platform vs merchant-owned field distinction, merge reversibility, and permanent audit trail requirements.

* **Section 9 \- Tier Drop Behavior.** Platform-wide badge reversion on Tier 1 drop, payment link continuity rules, section-specific tier preservation, and bank account update settlement freeze.

* **Section 10 \- Ops Process Requirements.** Six operational cases formally defined: TIN-matched duplicate review, corrective merge action, duplicate CR registration, non-taxable status reversal, bank account update post-Tier 3, and merge log review.

## **Updated Sections**

* **Section 3.1 Admin Verification:** Section-level CTA model documented. IBAN hard gate decision added. Taxable Business toggle renamed and logic clarified.

* **Section 3.3 Business Addition:** Duplicate CR registration scenarios added. Path C merge rule corrected \- gap-fill for enrichment events, full overwrite on merge trigger. Clean-slate opt-in added.

* **Section 5 Badge & Confidence Model:** Fourth internal quality label added \- Business Supplied (Path C creation mode).

* **Section 6 Field-Level Verification Matrix:** Freelancer row removed. TIN and VAT split into separate rows with distinct validation rules. IBAN hard gate rule added to verification method column.

# **PRD 1 \- Business Registration & Onboarding**

## **New Sections**

* **Section 9 \- Account Settings (Business Notification Email).** No dedicated business email at onboarding. Defaults to account creator's work email. Owner can set and update from account settings post-registration. FR-NS.1 through FR-NS.4.

* **Section 10 \- Account Lifecycle & Inactivity Policy.** Never submitted: 30-day warning, 60-day expiry. Action Required with no re-submission: 14-day warning, 30-day expiry. On expiry: soft-delete, CR/UNN released, email freed. FR-AL.1 through FR-AL.4.

## **Updated Requirements**

* **FR-1.6 (new) \- Duplicate CR at registration:** Active CR blocks with message to contact admin. Pending CR blocks and routes to ops.

* **FR-2.4 \- Auto-save semantics:** Blur \= local storage only. Save & Continue Later \= server-side persist. Cross-device continuation guaranteed only after server-side save. Resume banner appears only after server-side save.

* **FR-2.5 \- Section-by-section submission:** Each section submittable independently as soon as its required fields are complete. Admin review can begin on Section 1 before Sections 2 and 3 are submitted.

* **FR-3.1 \- Taxable Business toggle:** Toggle is On (taxable) by default. Switching Off is the non-taxable declaration. Warning and confirmation flow defined.

* **FR-3.2 / FR-3.3 \- Field logic:** Freelancer path removed. TIN and VAT Registration Number separated. 'VAT Registered?' checkbox added \- reveals VAT Registration Number and VAT Certificate upload when checked.

* **FR-7.3 \- Ownership invitation new-user flow:** Simplified to email (pre-filled, locked) \+ password only. No onboarding wizard. Owner lands directly on dashboard. Invitation tied to the specific invited email address.

* **FR-8.5 \- In-session business switching:** No logout required. Business switcher in the navigation bar. Same screen used at login and mid-session.

# **PRD 2 \- Trading Partner Management**

## **Document Renamed**

Previously titled 'PRD 2 \- Counterparty Management'. All section titles, field labels, UI copy, and references updated throughout.

## **New Sections**

* **Section 7 (expanded) \- Merge FRs:** Three new requirements added. FR-D.3: alias preservation at merge. FR-D.4: transaction re-pointing with merged record indicator. FR-D.7: immutable merge audit trail, accessible to Super Admin and Operations only. FR-D.9: clean-slate default with opt-in for pre-registration activity.

* **Section 8 (new) \- Concurrent Registration Scenarios:** Six scenarios defined covering all combinations of pending/Tier 1+ Businesses being added via Path A or Path B before and after self-registration.

## **Updated Requirements**

* **Section 2.1 \- Business Profile Fields:** Freelancer Certificate removed. TIN and VAT Registration Number split. Aliases field added. Business Supplied quality label added. Email and phone noted as platform-owned on merge.

* **FR-A.3 / FR-A.4 \- Path A badge behavior:** Tier 1+ match assigns Platform Verified badge immediately at record creation. Pending match assigns Unverified with CR/UNN and legal name pre-populated only.

* **Section 5.2 \- Path C merge logic corrected:** Gap-fill applies to enrichment events only. Full overwrite applies to the merge trigger event. Prior version incorrectly extended gap-fill protection to merge events.

* **FR-C.5 \- Quality labels:** Business Supplied added as the fourth label for Path C creation mode.

* **Non-functional requirements:** Implementation language removed. Audit trail permanence and merge atomicity added. Admin directory isolation exception noted with reference to PRD 3 role-based access controls.

# **PRD 3 \- Admin Verification Interface**

## **New Sections**

* **Section 2.1 \- Tier Drop Behavior on Rejection:** Cascading effects table. Section 1 drop: badge reverts platform-wide, new operations blocked, active links honoured. Section 2 drop: Tier 2 drops, Tier 1 preserved. Bank account update: settlement frozen, urgent queue flag.

* **Section 7 \- Ops Process Requirements:** Six ops cases with full FR-level requirements \- OP-1 through OP-6.

## **Updated Requirements**

* **Section-level CTA model throughout:** 'Approve Business' global CTA replaced. Each section has its own approval CTA. FR-R.1 updated \- CTA click is the explicit tier unlock trigger. FR-R.14 through FR-R.18 updated for section-level flows.

* **FR-Q.7 (new) \- Urgent queue flag:** Bank account update cases flagged as urgent and positioned at the top of queue ordering, above re-submissions.

* **FR-R.12 \- IBAN hard gate:** Invalid IBAN disables Approve action entirely. Valid is advisory \- admin must still cross-reference bank name before approving.

* **FR-R.22 \- Field unlock (renumbered):** Duplicate FR-R.19 from Section 4.4 resolved and renumbered FR-R.22.

* **FR-D.5 \- Role-based access in all-businesses directory:** Super Admin and Operations: full visibility. Support: identity fields only, no contact data. Finance/Settlement: bank fields only. Risk & Compliance: compliance fields only.

* **Queue columns:** Freelancer column removed. Urgency flag column added.

**Foundation PRDs \- Version 1.1 Release Notes**

* **Release Notes \- Version 1.1**   
* **Date:** April 2026\.   
* **Context:** Reflects decisions made during APEX development sessions. Changes to PRD 1 and PRD 3 only. PRD 2 unchanged.

**PRD 1 \- Business Registration & Onboarding**

* New Section 4.2 \- Step 1 Account Creator Details with 7 FRs covering role declaration, field collection, OTP mobile verification, designation dropdown, pre-fill logic for the owner path, no-pre-fill for the authorised path, and Save & Continue Later behaviour  
* Onboarding restructured from 3 to 4 steps throughout \- all section references, FR-2.x, step intros updated  
* FR-1.3 updated \- password complexity now includes all 5 rules with silent live validation (no focus loss)  
* Section 5 \- Ownership Invitation rewritten to reflect the conditional flow: invitation only shown in Step 3 for authorised registrants; company owners self-assign the Owner role  
* FR-7.2 rewritten \- self-invitation prompt replaced by Step 1 role declaration logic  
* FR-2.3 updated \- Save & Continue Later now triggers a dashboard resume banner showing the saved step with a Resume Now link  
* User Types table updated for both First Registrant and Legal Owner descriptions

**PRD 2 \- Counterparty Management**

No changes. Counterparty logic is unaffected by v1.1 decisions.

**PRD 3 \- Admin Verification Interface**

* FR-Q.5 updated \- Ownership invitation status column now has 4 states: Self-declared Owner, Accepted, Pending, Not sent  
* FR-Q.1 updated \- Queue explicitly limited to Pending Verification and Action Required businesses; active businesses excluded

# Business Logic Decisions Record

**Document 0 \- Business Logic Decisions Record**

Phase 1: Registration, Onboarding & Admin Verification

*Version 1.0  |  Status: Locked \- Source of truth for Phase 1 PRDs*

# **1\. Purpose & How to Use This Document**

This document is the authoritative record of every business logic decision covering business registration, onboarding, admin verification, tier unlocking, owner and admin structure, and taxability rules. It exists so that each Phase 1 PRD can stay focused on requirements without re-explaining the business logic that drives them.

Engineering teams should read this document once before reading either of the two Phase 1 companion PRDs. When a PRD states a rule \- "Tier 1 unlocks on Core Business Identification approval" or "non-taxable businesses have TIN but no VAT fields" \- the reasoning is here, not in the PRD itself.

This document is not a requirements document. It contains no functional requirements, acceptance criteria, or implementation detail. Those live in the PRDs.

| Document | Title & Scope |
| :---- | :---- |
| **PRD 1** | Business Registration & Onboarding \- covers sign-up, the onboarding wizard, ownership invitation, multi-business login, progressive tier unlocking, dashboard states, and re-submission flow. |
| **PRD 2** | Admin Verification Interface \- covers the verification queue, field-level review, section-level approval, tier unlocking CTAs, ops cases for the verification phase, and the all-businesses directory. |

# **2\. Data Model & Terminology Definitions**

This section establishes the canonical definitions for every entity and concept referenced across the Phase 1 PRDs. These definitions must be used consistently by Product, Design, and Engineering.

## **2.1 Core Entity Definitions**

| Concept | Definition |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Business** | The canonical real-world entity \- any company operating in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Identified uniquely by CRN (Commercial Registration Number) or UNN (Unified National Number), enforced as unique identifiers at the database level. The Business entity exists the moment it creates an account on the platform. Registration status is a property of the Business, not a different entity type. |
| **Badge** | A platform trust signal reflecting a Business's registration and verification state. Two states: Unverified (default) and Platform Verified (set when the Business reaches Tier 1). The badge is a property of the Business entity. |

## **2.2 Business Registration States**

Every Business on the platform exists in one of three internal states. These states drive badge assignment and platform behaviour.

| Internal State | Description | External Badge | Platform Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Not Registered** | The Business exists in the real world but has no APEX account. | Unverified | No platform access. |
| **Registered \- Pending** | The Business has created an APEX account and submitted for review. It has not yet reached Tier 1\. | Unverified | No transactional access. Platform tracks as a distinct state for ops purposes. |
| **Platform Verified** | The Business has self-registered and reached Tier 1\. Core Business Identification confirmed by admin. | Platform Verified | Full trust signal. Tier 1 capabilities active. |

The external badge is intentionally two-state. Both Not Registered and Registered-Pending are treated as Unverified externally. The internal three-state distinction is tracked at the platform level and informs ops workflows.

# **3\. Decisions**

## **3.1 Admin Verification & Progressive Access**

| Topic | Decision | Detail |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Tier model** | **Three tiers, independently unlocked** | Tier 1: Core Business Identification confirmed. Tier 2: full verification including owner identity. Tier 3: bank account verified. Admin unlocks each tier independently through section-level CTA confirmation. Not all-or-nothing. |
| **Tier 1 unlock** | **Core Business Identification section CTA** | Admin approves all actionable fields in the Core Business Identification section and clicks the section-level CTA ('Approve Core Business Identification → Unlock Business Access'). The Business immediately becomes Platform Verified and gains Tier 1 capabilities even while the rest of the review is ongoing. |
| **Tier 2 unlock** | **Beneficial Owners section CTA** | Admin approves all actionable fields in the Beneficial Owners section and clicks the section-level CTA. Core Business Identification (Tier 1\) must already be complete. Owner identity is part of Tier 2 \- not a separate gate above it. |
| **Tier 3 unlock** | **Bank Account section CTA** | Admin approves the IBAN field and clicks the section-level CTA. Tier 3 unlocks. Settlement payouts become available. Nothing else gates on bank verification. |
| **Taxable Business declaration** | **Toggle at onboarding, visible in admin review** | During onboarding the business sees a Taxable Business toggle. On by default (taxable \- normal state). Switching it Off triggers a warning: 'Declaring your business as non-taxable means VAT invoicing and ZATCA submission will not be available on APEX.' The business must confirm to proceed. When Off, VAT Registration Number and VAT Certificate upload are hidden from the onboarding form and from the admin review. TIN remains visible and required for all businesses regardless of toggle state. The admin sees a read-only label: 'Non-taxable business (self-declared)' alongside the TIN field for review. |
| **Buyer financing gate** | **Parked \- ARB dependency** | Whether owner verification or any specific tier is required for buyer financing with ARB is a banking partner requirement question, not a platform decision. Flagged as open pending ARB eligibility criteria. |
| **IBAN validation gate** | **Invalid \= hard gate; Valid \= advisory** | System performs mathematical IBAN validation (format and checksum) before the admin reviews the field. If the system result is Invalid, the admin Approve action is disabled \- the IBAN cannot be approved in an Invalid state. If the system result is Valid, the result is advisory: the admin uses it alongside the declared bank name to confirm the bank matches. A Valid result does not compel approval \- admin retains judgment on bank name match. |
| **Section-level CTA mechanics** | **Explicit confirmation per section** | Each of the three review sections has its own section-level CTA that is activated after all actionable fields in that section are individually approved. The section CTA is the explicit trigger for the corresponding tier unlock. Tier unlocks are not automatic on individual field approval \- they require the section-level CTA to be clicked. A 'Send Section for Correction' CTA is the rejection path at section level. |

## **3.2 ZATCA as a Verification Reference**

ZATCA is used as a reference portal by the admin during verification. It is not a data source for business record creation in Phase 1\.

| Topic | Decision | Detail |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **TIN verification** | **ZATCA portal** | Admin verifies the submitted Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN, 10-digit number) against the ZATCA portal. Required for all businesses regardless of taxability declaration. |
| **VAT Registration Number verification** | **ZATCA portal** | Admin verifies the submitted VAT Registration Number (15-digit, starting and ending with 3\) against the ZATCA portal. Only applicable to taxable businesses. Not shown for non-taxable businesses. |
| **CR validation** | **Explicit admin step** | Admin cross-references the submitted CR against the MoC public portal to confirm the CR is active and registered. This is an explicit step in the verification review \- not an automated check. MoC confirmation checkbox required before CR approval can be saved. Wathq API integration is a future enhancement \- see Section 9\. |

## **3.3 Transaction Permissions**

| Topic | Decision | Detail |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Permission axis** | **Verification status** | Transaction permissions are driven by the verification tier of the registered business. Taxability drives document compliance rules (ZATCA submission, invoice type) separately. These are not the same axis and must not be conflated in access logic. |
| **Non-taxable businesses** | **Full permissions once verified** | Non-taxable businesses receive full Tier 2 permissions once admin-verified. ZATCA submission is blocked and clearly communicated. Financing eligibility is subject to ARB partner criteria \- not a platform decision. |

## **3.4 Business Owner vs. User Verification**

| Topic | Decision | Detail |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **First registrant role declaration** | **Captured at registration** | The onboarding form asks the registrant to declare their role upfront: either 'I am the company owner' or 'I am authorised to register this business'. This declaration drives role assignment and downstream flows. |
| **Owner-direct path** | **Owner role assigned immediately** | When the registrant declares they are the company owner, the Owner role is assigned to them upon registration. No invitation flow is triggered. |
| **Authorised-registrant path** | **Admin role assigned; Owner invited separately** | When the registrant declares they are authorised but not the owner, they receive the Admin role. The Admin then sends an ownership invitation to the legal owner's email. The legal owner accepts, creates or connects their APEX account, and the Owner role is assigned to them. |
| **Ownership invitation \- new user** | **Simplified account creation** | When the invited owner has no existing APEX account, they see a simplified account creation screen \- email (pre-filled from the invitation address, locked) and password only. No full sign-up flow and no onboarding wizard. On account creation, the Owner role is assigned and the owner lands directly on the business dashboard. The invitation link is tied to the specific email it was sent to \- attempts to register under a different email are rejected. |
| **Ownership invitation scope** | **Authorised-registrant path only** | The ownership invitation flow applies exclusively when the registrant declared themselves as authorised. It does not exist in the owner-direct path, where the owner has already self-identified. |
| **Tier 2 dependency on ownership** | **None** | Tier 2 unlocks on verification regardless of path or whether the ownership invitation has been accepted. Admin role is sufficient for all Tier 2 commercial operations. |
| **Financing gate** | **Authorised signatory \- not Owner role** | Financing requires a designated authorised signatory with verified identity. This is independent of path or Owner role status. |
| **Ownership-exclusive actions** | **Unavailable until Owner role is active** | Ownership transfer and account deletion require the Owner role. In the owner-direct path this is available immediately. In the authorised-registrant path these actions are unavailable until the invitation is accepted. |
| **Beneficial owner fields \- owner-direct path** | **Collapse into registrant** | When the registrant is the owner, their registration details serve as the beneficial owner record. No separate beneficial owner capture is required. |
| **Beneficial owner fields \- authorised-registrant path** | **Always captured separately** | When the registrant is not the owner, the onboarding form captures the legal owner's details as required fields. The admin verification team verifies these as part of standard review. |
| **Subsequent users** | **No independent verification** | Invited users do not need independent identity verification once the business is verified and they are invited through the Owner or Admin account. |

# **4\. Progressive Access Summary**

The table below defines what each tier unlock enables and which admin action triggers it. This is the authoritative reference for tier logic across Phase 1\.

| Tier | Admin action that triggers it | What unlocks for the business |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Tier 1 \- Core Business Identification confirmed** | Admin approves all Section 1 actionable fields and clicks the section-level CTA | Platform login. Business appears as Platform Verified. Platform-level capabilities become available (view invoices, import invoices via Invoice Module, add to business network). |
| **Tier 2 \- Beneficial Owners confirmed** | Admin approves all Section 2 actionable fields and clicks the section-level CTA | Full commercial operations: issuing invoices, payment links, ZATCA submission (taxable businesses only), credit notes, receiving payments, invoice financing submissions. |
| **Tier 3 \- Bank Account confirmed** | Admin approves IBAN field and clicks the section-level CTA | Settlement payouts to verified bank account. All Tier 2 operations continue unaffected. |

Ownership transfer and account deletion are Owner-role exclusive and are independent of verification tier. These actions are unavailable in the authorised-registrant path until the ownership invitation is accepted.

# **5\. Business Badge Model**

Two external badge states exist on the platform.

| Badge | Trigger | Meaning |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Unverified** | Default state for all businesses | Business has not yet reached Tier 1\. |
| **Platform Verified** | Business reaches Tier 1 (Core Business Identification confirmed by admin) | Business has passed core identity verification. Full trust signal on the platform. |

# **6\. Field-Level Verification Matrix**

The matrix below defines every field presented to the admin in the verification review, the action available on each field, which tier that field's approval contributes to unlocking, and the verification method the admin uses.

| Field | Admin action | Tier unlocked | Verification method |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| ***Section 1 \- Core Business Identification (full section approval \+ section CTA click unlocks Tier 1\)*** |  |  |  |
| **CR/UNN Number** | Approve / Reject | Tier 1 | Cross-check against uploaded CR certificate. Admin must also cross-reference the CR number against the MoC public portal to confirm the CR is active and registered. MoC confirmation checkbox required before approval can be saved. |
| **Legal Business Name (Arabic)** | Approve / Reject | Tier 1 | Must match exactly as it appears on the CR certificate. |
| **Upload CR Certificate** | Approve / Reject | Tier 1 | Admin opens document and confirms legal name and CR number match submission. Document must be unexpired. |
| **Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN)** | Approve / Reject | Tier 1 | Verified via ZATCA portal. 10-digit number. Always present and required for all businesses regardless of taxability declaration. |
| **VAT Registration Number** | Approve / Reject | Tier 1 | Verified via ZATCA portal. 15-digit number starting and ending with 3\. Only shown if business declared VAT-registered (Taxable Business toggle On). Hidden for non-taxable businesses. |
| **Upload VAT Certificate** | Approve / Reject | Tier 1 | Admin opens document and confirms VAT number matches submission. Only shown for taxable businesses. |
| **Non-taxable declaration** | Display only | \- | Read-only label shown when business switched the Taxable Business toggle Off at onboarding: 'Non-taxable business (self-declared)'. VAT Registration Number and VAT Certificate upload are absent. TIN remains present and must be approved. Admin takes no action on this label. |
| **Registered Address (National Address)** | Display only | \- | Not verified by admin. Shown for reference only. |
| ***Section 2 \- Beneficial Owners (full section approval \+ section CTA click completes Tier 2\)*** |  |  |  |
| **Full Name** | Approve / Reject | Tier 2 | Cross-check against uploaded owner ID document. Name must match exactly. When registrant declared company ownership, this field is pre-filled from Step 1 Account Creator Details. |
| **National ID (Saudi) or Iqama (resident)** | Approve / Reject | Tier 2 | Cross-check against uploaded ID document. Number must match. |
| **Upload ID Copy (National ID, Passport, or Iqama)** | Approve / Reject | Tier 2 | Admin opens document and confirms it is clear, valid, unexpired, and matches name and ID number submitted. |
| ***Section 3 \- Bank Account Details (IBAN approval \+ section CTA click unlocks Tier 3\)*** |  |  |  |
| **IBAN** | Approve / Reject | Tier 3 | System performs mathematical IBAN validation (format and checksum) before the review view renders. Admin sees validation result (Valid / Invalid) next to the IBAN field. If result is Invalid, the Approve action is disabled \- admin can only reject. If result is Valid, admin cross-references the bank name derived from the IBAN against the business's declared bank name before approving. Valid result is advisory \- not a compelled approval. |
| **Bank Name** | Display only | \- | Auto-derived from IBAN. No independent admin action required. |
| **Account Holder Name** | Display only | \- | Shown for reference alongside IBAN. |
| **Bank Account Number** | Display only | \- | Shown for reference. |

Approving all actionable fields in Section 1 and clicking the section CTA unlocks Tier 1\. For non-taxable businesses, VAT Registration Number and VAT Certificate are absent \- the section is complete without them. Approving all actionable fields in Section 2 and clicking the section CTA completes Tier 2\. Section 3 IBAN approval and section CTA independently unlocks Tier 3\.

# **7\. Tier Drop Behavior (Edge Cases)**

When the admin rejects a field in a section that was previously fully approved, the Business drops below the tier associated with that section. This section defines the cascading effects.

| Topic | Decision | Detail |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Badge on tier drop** | **Reverts immediately** | When a Business drops below Tier 1 due to a Section 1 field rejection, its badge reverts from Platform Verified to Unverified immediately. |
| **Active payment links on tier drop** | **Existing links honoured; new operations blocked** | Payment links already generated under Tier 2 remain valid and honoured \- they reflect the tier state at creation. From the moment of tier drop, new Tier 2 operations are blocked: no new payment links, no new invoices, no new ZATCA submissions, until the tier is restored through re-approval. |
| **Historical documents on tier drop** | **Immutable** | Historical invoices and documents issued under the dropped tier are never retroactively affected by the tier change. They always reflect the state at creation time. |
| **Section-specific tier preservation** | **Tier 1 preserved when only Section 2 fields rejected** | If a business is at Tier 2 and a Section 2 field is rejected, the business drops below Tier 2 but retains Tier 1\. Tier 1 is only revoked if Section 1 fields are rejected. Tier 1 capabilities remain active during a Section 2 Action Required state. |
| **Bank account update \- Tier 3** | **Settlement frozen during re-verification** | When a Tier 3 business updates their bank account details, Tier 3 is immediately suspended. Settlement payouts are frozen \- no payouts to old or new IBAN during the review period. The bank account update is flagged as urgent in the admin queue. Tier 3 reinstates immediately upon admin approval of the new IBAN. The business is notified at submission that settlement will freeze until the new IBAN is approved. |

# **8\. Ops Process Requirements**

The following cases require defined operational processes in PRD 2 (Admin Verification Interface). Each case represents a scenario where the platform surfaces a case to the Qawafel Operations team requiring human judgment and action.

| Case | Name | Trigger | Ops Action Required |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **1** | **Bank Account Update Post-Tier 3** | Tier 3 business submits a new IBAN | Case flagged as urgent in admin queue. Ops prioritises review to minimise settlement freeze window. Admin reviews new IBAN using same mathematical validation and bank name cross-reference as initial verification. Tier 3 reinstates on approval. |

| Item | Detail |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Wathq integration** | Automated real-time CR and National ID validation via Wathq API. Deferred \- admin manual review via MoC portal is the sole CR verification path until Wathq is live. |
| **Buyer financing \- ARB criteria** | Whether owner verification or a specific tier is required for buyer financing with ARB. This is an ARB banking partner requirement, not a platform decision. Flagged as open pending ARB eligibility specification. |

# PRD 1 Business Registration & Onboarding

**PRD 1 \- Business Registration & Onboarding**

Sign-Up, Onboarding Wizard, Ownership Invitation, Multi-Business Login & Progressive Access

*Version 1.0  |  Status: Draft \- Internal EPD Review*

*Depends on: Document 0 \- Business Logic Decisions Record (Phase 1\)  |  Companion: PRD 2 (Admin Verification Interface)*

# **1\. Purpose & Scope**

This PRD defines the complete business registration and onboarding experience on the APEX platform. It covers sign-up, the onboarding wizard, the ownership invitation mechanic, multi-business login and in-session switching, the progressive tier unlocking model as admin sections are approved, dashboard states per tier, the re-submission flow when the admin rejects fields, account settings, and account lifecycle policies.

|  |  |
| :---- | :---- |
| **In scope** | Sign-up (email \+ password). Onboarding wizard: Step 1 Account Creator Details, Step 2 Core Business Identification, Step 3 Beneficial Owners, Step 4 Bank Account Details. Taxable Business toggle. VAT-registered declaration. Section-by-section submission. Ownership invitation flow (conditional on role declared in Step 1). Save & Continue Later with dashboard resume banner. Multi-business login, entity selection, and in-session context switching. Dashboard states per verification tier. Re-submission flow after admin rejection. Account settings including business notification email. Account lifecycle and inactivity expiry policy. Tier unlock notifications. |
| **Out of scope \-** **Deferred** | Sign up using mobile \+ Opt \- OAuth sign-up (Google / Microsoft) \- deferred. OTP email verification at sign-up \- deferred. Forgot password / password reset \- deferred. Plan selection and payment integration \- deferred. ZATCA integration during onboarding \- deferred. Wathq real-time CR validation \- deferred. |
| **Depends on** | Document 0 for all business logic. PRD 2 (Admin Verification Interface) for the admin-side section approvals that trigger tier unlocks referenced in this PRD. |

# **2\. User Types**

| First Registrant | The person who creates the business account on APEX. Receives the Admin or Owner role depending on their role declaration in Step 1\. Declares their role in Step 1 of the onboarding wizard: either as the company owner or as an authorised registrant. Their Full Name, Work Email, Mobile Number, and Designation are captured in Step 1\. No restriction on who registers. |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Legal Owner / Authorised Representative** | The individual named on the Commercial Registration as the legal representative. Their identity details are captured in Step 3 (Beneficial Owners). If the first registrant declared themselves as the company owner in Step 1, their Step 1 data pre-fills Step 3 fields and no ownership invitation is sent. If the first registrant declared themselves as an authorised registrant, an ownership invitation is shown in Step 3 and sent to the legal owner, who accepts and holds the Owner role. |
| **Multi-Business User** | A user who is a member of more than one business on APEX. At login they see a business selection screen and choose which business context to enter. Once inside the platform, they can switch between businesses using the in-session business switcher in the navigation bar \- no logout required. The business selection screen used at login and the in-session switcher share the same interface and logic. |

# **3\. Sign-Up & Sign In/Login**

## **3.1 Sign Up**

Sign-up is the first step. A person creates their APEX user account with email and password. There is no verification step, no OTP, and no social login in this phase. On successful registration the user proceeds immediately to the onboarding wizard.

| FR ID | Requirement | Acceptance Criteria | Priority |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **FR-1.1** | Sign-up screen accepts email address and password only. | User submits email \+ password and account is created. System redirects to onboarding wizard immediately. | Must Have |
| **FR-1.2** | Email address must be unique across all APEX accounts. | Duplicate email returns inline error: 'An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.' | Must Have |
| **FR-1.3** | Password minimum complexity: at least 12 characters, 1 uppercase letter, 1 lowercase letter, 1 special character, 1 number. A live validation checklist is shown as the user types \- each rule turns green when met. | Live checklist updates silently on each keystroke. All five rules must be met before the form can be submitted. Submit button disabled until all rules satisfied. | Must Have |
| **FR-1.4** | No OTP, no email verification, no SSO buttons in this phase. | Sign-up screen contains none of these elements. | Must Have |
| **FR-1.5** | On successful sign-up the user is directed to the onboarding wizard Step 1 (Account Creator Details) with no intermediate screen. | Onboarding wizard Step 1 loads immediately after account creation. | Must Have |

## **3.1 Sign In/Login**

Sign-in allows registered users to access their APEX account using their email address and password. There is no OTP, no mobile-based sign-in, and no social login in this phase. On successful sign-in the user is redirected to their business dashboard or the business selection screen depending on their business membership count.

| FR ID | Requirement | Acceptance Criteria | Priority |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **FR-SI.1** | Sign-in screen accepts email address and password only. | User enters registered email and password. On correct credentials the platform redirects based on business membership count per FR-SI.4. No OTP, no mobile sign-in, and no social login options are present in this phase. | Must Have |
| **FR-SI.2** | Incorrect credentials return a generic inline error with no distinction between an unrecognised email and a wrong password. | On failed sign-in attempt the screen displays: 'Incorrect email or password. Please try again.' The error message does not indicate whether the email exists on the platform. | Must Have |
| **FR-SI.3** | After 5 consecutive failed sign-in attempts on the same email address, the account is temporarily locked for 15 minutes. | Lockout activates after the 5th consecutive failed attempt. A lockout notice replaces the generic error: 'Your account has been temporarily locked due to multiple failed sign-in attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.' The lockout timer resets from the last failed attempt. The account unlocks automatically after 15 minutes with no manual intervention required. A successful sign-in at any point before lockout resets the failure counter to zero. | Deferred |
| **FR-SI.4** | On successful sign-in the user is redirected based on their business membership count. | Users belonging to a single business land directly on that business dashboard. Users belonging to more than one business are shown the business selection screen before the dashboard. Redirect logic is consistent with the in-session business switcher behaviour defined in the Multi-Business Login section. | Must Have |
| **FR-SI.5** | Forgot password and password reset \- Deferred. | No forgot password link or reset flow is present in this phase. The sign-in screen contains no forgot password CTA. | Deferred |
| **FR-SI.6** | Sign-in via mobile number and OTP \- Deferred. | Mobile number and OTP-based sign-in is not available in this phase. | Deferred |

# **4\. Onboarding Wizard**

The onboarding wizard collects all information required for admin verification. It is divided into four steps. Step 1 (Account Creator Details) and Step 2 (Core Business Identification) are mandatory and cannot be skipped. Steps 3 and 4 can be saved and completed later. Each section can be submitted independently for admin review as soon as its required fields are complete \- full completion of all four steps is not required before section-level submission begins.

## **4.1 Wizard Structure & Navigation**

| FR ID | Requirement | Acceptance Criteria | Priority |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **FR-2.1** | The wizard has four steps: Account Creator Details (Step 1), Core Business Identification (Step 2), Beneficial Owners (Step 3), Bank Account Details (Step 4). A progress indicator shows completion status per step. | Progress indicator shows four steps. Each step shows Completed, Current, or Incomplete state. | Must Have |
| **FR-2.2** | Steps 1 and 2 cannot be skipped. Step 1 requires role selection and all required fields before proceeding. Step 2 requires all required fields before proceeding to Step 3\. | No Skip button on Steps 1 or 2\. | Must Have |
| **FR-2.3** | Steps 3 and 4 can be partially completed and saved for later via Save & Continue Later. When the user saves mid-wizard and navigates away, a resume banner appears on the Dashboard showing the step they left on with a direct Resume Now link. | Partial progress persists. On return wizard opens at the saved step with all previously entered data pre-filled. Dashboard shows resume banner with step reference. Banner disappears on submission. | Must Have |
| **FR-2.4** | All form fields auto-save on blur using local storage \- no server call per field interaction. Save & Continue Later triggers an explicit server-side save, persisting all current field values to the server. Server-side persistence guarantees cross-device and cross-browser continuation. If the user closes the browser without clicking Save & Continue Later, local storage preserves progress for same-device same-browser return only. The resume dashboard banner appears only after a server-side save event. | Blur auto-save uses local storage. Save & Continue Later persists to server. Cross-device continuation supported when server-side save has been triggered. Resume banner visible only after server-side save. | Must Have |
| **FR-2.5** | Each section can be submitted for admin review independently as soon as its required fields are complete. A Submit Section for Review CTA is available per section. Full completion of all four steps is not required before the first section-level submission. | Section-level Submit for Review CTA available when section's required fields are complete. Admin queue receives section submission. Business status reflects which sections are under review. Sections not yet submitted show as Not Submitted in progress view. | Must Have |
| **FR-2.6** | On section submission the submitted section's status changes to Pending Verification and the admin queue receives the section submission. | After submission the user sees a section confirmation. Section status in admin views shows Pending Verification. | Must Have |

## **4.2 Step 1 \- Account Creator Details**

Step 1 is the first and mandatory step of the onboarding wizard. It captures the identity and role of the person registering the business. The role declared here determines whether an ownership invitation is required in Step 3\.

| FR ID | Requirement | Acceptance Criteria | Priority |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **FR-AC.1** | Step 1 requires role declaration before any other fields appear. The registrant selects one of two mutually exclusive options: 'I am the company owner' or 'I am authorised to register this business'. Selection is required to proceed. | Role selection rendered as two radio-button cards. No other fields visible until a role is selected. Continue button disabled until role is selected. | Must Have |
| **FR-AC.2** | Required fields collected in Step 1: Full Name, Work Email (Prefiled), Mobile Number, Designation. | All three fields required. Form does not proceed without all fields completed. | Must Have |
| **FR-AC.3** | Mobile Number is collected and verified via OTP in Step 1\. OTP verification is completed once at onboarding and not repeated on subsequent logins. The mobile number is not part of the admin verification review. | Mobile number field with Saudi format validation (+966) 5X XXX XXXX). OTP sent on request. Verification marked complete on correct OTP entry. OTP verification status stored on the user record. | Must Have |
| **FR-AC.4** | Designation is collected via a dropdown. Options: Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Chief Financial Officer (CFO), Chief Operating Officer (COO), Managing Director, General Manager, Finance Manager, Operations Manager, Business Development Manager, Procurement Manager, Sales Manager, Legal Counsel, Compliance Officer, Authorised Signatory, Other. Selecting Other reveals a required free-text field. | Dropdown contains all listed options. Selecting Other shows a required free-text field. Form does not proceed without a designation selected or specified. | Must Have |
| **FR-AC.5** | When the registrant selects 'I am the company owner': their Full Name from Step 1 is treated as the legal owner name for the admin verification review. Step 3 (Beneficial Owners) pre-fills Full Name. Pre-filled fields are dimmed and read-only in Step 3\. | Step 3 Full Name field pre-populated and read-only when role is company owner. Step 3 shows a contextual banner: 'You declared yourself as the company owner in Step 1\. Your details have been pre-filled below.' | Must Have |
| **FR-AC.6** | When the registrant selects 'I am authorised to register this business': Step 3 (Beneficial Owners) does not pre-fill any fields from Step 1\. An ownership invitation section appears in Step 3 for the registrant to invite the legal owner. | Step 3 fields empty and editable when role is authorised registrant. Ownership invitation section visible in Step 3\. No pre-fill applied. | Must Have |

## **4.3 Step 2 \- Core Business Identification**

Step 2 collects the business's legal and tax identity. This step is mandatory and cannot be skipped. Completing and submitting this step feeds the Core Business Identification section in the admin review \- full admin approval of this section unlocks Tier 1 for the business.

| FR ID | Requirement | Acceptance Criteria | Priority |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **FR-3.1** | A Taxable Business toggle is shown prominently in Step 2\. The toggle is On by default \- this is the normal state for a taxable business. Switching the toggle Off triggers a warning before confirming: 'Declaring your business as non-taxable means VAT invoicing and ZATCA submission will not be available on APEX.' The user must confirm to proceed. | Toggle On by default. Warning modal shown on toggle-Off. User must click Confirm to activate non-taxable declaration. Toggle state stored on the business record. Confirmation can be cancelled \- toggle returns to On. | Must Have |
| **FR-3.2** | When the Taxable Business toggle is On (default \- taxable business): required fields are CR/UNN number (10 digits starting with 1 or 7), legal business name in Arabic, CR Certificate upload, Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN, 10 digits), VAT Registration Number (15-digit, starting and ending with 3), VAT Certificate upload, and national address. | All fields visible and required. Format validation on CR/UNN (10 digits, starts 1 or 7), TIN (10 digits), and VAT Registration Number (15 digits, starts and ends with 3). Inline errors shown per field. | Must Have |
| **FR-3.3** | When the Taxable Business toggle is Off (non-taxable declaration): VAT Registration Number and VAT Certificate upload disappear from Step 2 entirely. TIN remains visible and required \- it is always required for all businesses regardless of taxability. | Switching Taxable Business toggle Off immediately hides VAT Registration Number and VAT Certificate upload. TIN field remains visible and required. Step cannot be completed without TIN regardless of toggle state. | Must Have |
| **FR-3.4** | All document uploads in Step 2 accept PDF, JPG, PNG. Maximum 20MB per file. A preview is shown after upload. | Files outside accepted types or over 20MB show an inline error. Valid uploads show a preview thumbnail. | Must Have |

# **7\. Dashboard States per Verification Tier**

The dashboard experience changes as the business progresses through verification tiers. Each tier has a defined banner, access level, and primary CTA. Tiers are unlocked progressively as the admin approves individual sections and clicks the section-level CTA \- not all-or-nothing. See Document 0 Section 4 (Progressive Access Summary) for the full capability list per tier.

## **7.1 Dashboard States**

| Status | Banner message | Platform access | Primary CTA |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Pending Verification (submitted, awaiting review)** | Your account is under review. Estimated review time: 24–48 hours. You can explore the platform in the meantime. | Platform navigation visible but all transactional features locked. | Explore Platform |
| **Tier 1 \- Core Business Identification Confirmed (mid-review)** | Your business identity has been confirmed. Your business is now listed as Platform Verified. Full commercial access unlocks once your complete review is approved. | Platform login. View imported invoices. Import invoices. Appear as Platform Verified to others. | Explore Platform |
| **Action Required (fields rejected)** | Action needed \- some information requires correction. Please review and resubmit. | Same as pre-submission. Fix Issues Now CTA opens the re-submission wizard. | Fix Issues Now |
| **Tier 2 \- Verified, Bank account pending** | Your account is verified. Your bank account details are pending verification. Settlement payouts will be available once verified. | Full commercial access: invoicing, payment links, payments, ZATCA submission (taxable businesses), invoice financing. Settlement payouts not yet available. | Explore Platform |
| **Tier 3 \- Fully Active, Bank account Verified** | Full access, no restrictions. | All platform capabilities including settlement payouts. | Banner dismiss |

Tier banners are shown on the dashboard page. The Action Required banner is not dismissible. When all tiers are approved, a dismiss CTA appears to remove the banner.

| **FR-10.2** | Within each step only rejected fields are editable. Approved fields are shown as read-only with a green Verified indicator. | Approved fields cannot be edited in the re-submission flow. Rejected fields are highlighted with rejection reason displayed beneath them. | Must Have |
| **FR-10.3** | Each rejected field shows the rejection reason provided by the admin and the corrective action required. | Rejection reason displayed as inline helper text below the rejected field. | Must Have |
| **FR-10.4** | The business can correct rejected fields and submit for re-review. Re-submission routes to the top of the admin verification queue. | Resubmit CTA submits only the corrected fields. Business status returns to Pending Verification. Admin queue shows this as a re-submission with attempt number. | Must Have |

# **9\. Account Settings (Minimum FR)**

Account settings are accessible to the Owner and Admin roles from the platform navigation. This section covers settings that affect the business account rather than individual user preferences. The work email and mobile number captured in Step 1 of the onboarding wizard are the registrant's personal contact details used for authentication purposes only. Business-level communication settings are managed here by the Owner or the Admin.

## **9.1 Business Notification Email**

All platform notifications are delivered to the business notification email and business mobile number. By default these are the account creator's work email and mobile number. No gap in notifications during the period before the business notification email and mobile number are set. | Must Have |
| **FR-NS.3** | Once set, the business notification email and business mobile number receive all platform notifications: tier unlock confirmations, rejection alerts, re-submission confirmations, and ownership invitation emails. | All notification types route to the business notification email and business mobile number after they are set. Previous notifications delivered to account creator's contact details are not affected. | Must Have |

# **10\. Account Lifecycle & Inactivity Policy**

The platform enforces an inactivity policy to prevent abandoned registrations from holding CR numbers indefinitely. CR uniqueness is enforced at the database level \- an abandoned registration that holds a CR number permanently could block legitimate future registrations for that business. The inactivity rules apply universally regardless of prior tier status.

| FR ID | Requirement | Acceptance Criteria | Priority |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **FR-AL.1** | Accounts created but never submitted for review are subject to inactivity expiry. A warning email is sent after 30 days of inactivity. If no action is taken within 60 days of account creation, the registration expires. | Warning email sent at 30-day inactivity mark. Expiry occurs at 60 days of inactivity if no action taken after warning. Warning email directs the user to resume their onboarding. | Must Have |
| **FR-AL.2** | Accounts in Action Required state with no re-submission activity are subject to a shorter inactivity threshold regardless of prior verification tier. A warning email is sent after 14 days of inactivity. If no re-submission is made within 30 days of the rejection, the registration expires. CR/UNN released, email freed, record soft-deleted. | Warning email sent at 14-day inactivity mark. Expiry occurs at 30 days if no re-submission after warning. | Must Have |
| **FR-AL.3** | On expiry: the registration record is soft-deleted, the CR/UNN number is released and becomes available for a new registration attempt, and the email address is freed for re-use. | Registration record soft-deleted on expiry. CR/UNN number released and available immediately for a new registration. Email address freed. Soft-deleted record preserved internally for audit purposes \- not permanently purged. | Must Have |
| **FR-AL.4** | Warning emails are sent to the registrant's work email and include a clear call to action to resume onboarding or re-submit corrections. | Warning email includes direct link to resume or resubmit. Email content follows notification definitions in Section 11\. | Must Have |

# **11\. Notifications**

| Notification | Trigger & Content |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Sign-up confirmation** | Triggered on successful account creation. Sent to registrant's email. Content: welcome message, next step instruction (complete onboarding). |
| **Section submission confirmation** | Triggered when the business submits a section for review. Sent to business notification email. Content: section submitted, expected review timeline (24–48 hours first submission, 12–24 hours re-submissions). |
| **Tier 1 unlocked** | Triggered when admin approves all Core Business Identification fields and clicks section CTA. In-app: dashboard banner updates to Tier 1 state. |
| **Tier 2 unlocked** | Triggered when admin approves all Beneficial Owners fields and clicks section CTA. In-app: verification badge enabled, success banner shown. |
| **Action Required (rejection)** | Triggered when admin clicks Send Section for Correction. In-app: Action Required banner with Fix Issues Now CTA. Sent to business notification email. |
| **Re-submission confirmation** | Triggered when the business submits corrections. Sent to business notification email. Content: re-submission received, priority review timeline (12–24 hours). |
| **Tier 3 unlocked** | Triggered when admin approves the IBAN field and clicks section CTA. In-app: bank pending banner resolves, settlement payouts become available. |
| **Ownership invitation** | Sent to the legal owner's email when Admin submits the invitation (authorised-registrant path only). Content: invitation to join as Owner, unique link (expires 72 hours), business name and registrant details. |
| **Ownership accepted** | Triggered when the legal owner accepts the invitation. In-app: Owner role assigned, ownership-exclusive actions become available. |
| **Inactivity warning** | Triggered at 30-day inactivity mark (never submitted) or 14-day mark (Action Required with no re-submission). Sent to registrant's work email. Content: warning of impending expiry, call to action to resume or resubmit. |

# PRD 2 Admin Verification Interface

**PRD 2 \- Admin Verification Interface**

Verification Queue, Section-Level Approval, Tier Unlocking, Field-Level Review, Submission History & Ops Process Requirements

*Version 1.0  |  Status: Draft \- Internal EPD Review*

*Depends on: Document 0 \- Business Logic Decisions Record (Phase 1\)  |  Companion: PRD 1 (Business Registration & Onboarding)*

# **1\. Purpose & Scope**

This PRD defines the admin verification interface \- the tools Qawafel Operations staff use to review business submissions, approve or reject individual fields, confirm tier unlocks through section-level CTAs, and manage operational cases including inactive accounts, bank account updates.

The verification model is progressive, not all-or-nothing. Admin reviews fields within each section independently. When all actionable fields in a section are approved, the admin clicks the section-level CTA to confirm the section and trigger the corresponding tier unlock. Tier unlocks are not automatic on field approval \- they require the explicit section-level CTA. Each tier unlock is immediate \- the business gains the corresponding capabilities while the rest of the review is still in progress.

All business logic decisions are in Document 0\. This PRD contains admin interface requirements and acceptance criteria only.

|  |  |
| :---- | :---- |
| **In scope** | Pending verification queue with tier-aware status and queue ordering. Field-level approve/reject with section-level CTA for independent tier unlocking. Non-taxable declaration handling. CR cross-reference step. IBAN mathematical validation display with hard gate for Invalid results. Submission history and re-submission comparison view. Ownership invitation monitoring. All-businesses directory with role-based access controls. Bank account update post-Tier 3 handling in Pending Queue. Tier drop cascading effects. |
| **Out of scope** | Wathq API integration \- deferred. Admin dashboard analytics \- deferred. Bulk actions across multiple businesses \- deferred. Business impersonation \- Roles & Permissions PRD. Admin-initiated business creation \- future capability. Automated document quality checks \- deferred. |
| **Admin roles with access** | Operations: full access \- primary role for verification. Super Admin: full access. Support: view-only \- can see records and history, cannot approve, reject, or change status. Finance/Settlement: bank details and settlement-relevant fields. Risk & Compliance: risk flags and compliance-relevant fields. |

# **2\. Business Status Model (Admin View)**

| Status | Definition |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Pending Verification** | Business submitted for review. No tier unlocked. Admin review not yet started or in progress. Admin can begin reviewing fields and unlock tiers as sections are approved via section-level CTAs. |
| **Tier 1 Active (mid-review)** | Admin approved all actionable fields in Section 1 and clicked the 'Approve Core Business Identification → Unlock Business Access' CTA. Business has Tier 1 capabilities and appears as Platform Verified. Section 2 and/or Section 3 review still pending. |
| **Tier 2 Active (mid-review)** | Admin approved all of Section 1 and Section 2 and clicked both section-level CTAs. Business has full commercial capabilities. Section 3 (Bank) review may still be pending. |
| **Action Required** | Admin clicked 'Send Section for Correction'. One or more fields rejected. Business notified. Tier drop effects apply as defined below. |
| **Active (Tier 2 or Tier 3\)** | All required sections fully approved via section CTAs. Business has full access. Business exits the queue. |

## **2.1 Tier Drop Behavior on Rejection**

Tier drops have cascading effects that must be handled explicitly by the platform.

| Scenario | Cascading Effects |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Section 1 field rejected \- Tier 1 drop** | Business drops below Tier 1\. Badge reverts from Platform Verified to Unverified immediately. Active payment links already generated remain valid and honoured. New Tier 1 and Tier 2 operations blocked from moment of tier drop. Historical documents are immutable. |
| **Section 2 field rejected \- Tier 2 drop** | Business drops below Tier 2 but retains Tier 1\. Tier 1 capabilities (view, appear as Platform Verified) remain active. Payment links already generated under Tier 2 remain valid and honoured. New Tier 2 operations (payment links, invoices, ZATCA submission) blocked until Section 2 corrections are re-approved. |
| **Section 3 field rejected \- Tier 3 suspended** | Settlement payouts suspended until bank account is re-verified. Tier 2 operations unaffected. Business retains full commercial capabilities. |
| **Bank account update post-Tier 3** | When a Tier 3 business submits a new IBAN, Tier 3 is immediately suspended. Settlement payouts frozen \- no payouts to old or new IBAN during review. Case flagged as urgent in Pending Queue. Tier 3 reinstated on IBAN approval. Business notified of settlement freeze at submission. |

# **3\. Pending Verification Queue**

The Pending Queue is the primary working view for the Operations team. It shows all businesses with status Pending Verification or Action Required. Active businesses do not appear in the queue. Bank account update post-Tier 3 cases are surfaced here as urgent \- they are tied directly to the verification tier and must be actioned with minimum delay to lift the settlement freeze.

## **3.1 Queue Columns**

* Business legal name (Arabic)

* CR/UNN number

* Submission date and time

* Attempt number \- 1st, 2nd, 3rd… (re-submissions clearly badged)

* Current tier status \- Unstarted, Tier 1 Active, Tier 2 Active, Action Required

* Ownership invitation status \- Self-declared Owner / Accepted / Pending (with days elapsed since sent) / Not sent

* Non-taxable indicator \- flagged where the business declared non-taxable at onboarding

* Urgency flag \- flagged for bank account update cases requiring expedited review

* Review CTA \- opens the business detail and review view

## **3.2 Queue Ordering**

Urgent cases (bank account update post-Tier 3\) appear first. Re-submissions (attempt number \>= 2\) appear next regardless of submission time. New first-time submissions follow in FIFO order by submission timestamp.

## **3.3 Queue Functional Requirements**

| FR ID | Requirement | Acceptance Criteria | Priority |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **FR-Q.1** | Queue shows only businesses with status Pending Verification or Action Required. Active businesses are absent from the queue unless a re-submission is pending. | Active businesses absent from queue unless a re-submission is pending. | Must Have |
| **FR-Q.2** | Queue sorted: urgent cases first, then re-submissions, then FIFO by submission timestamp. | Bank account update cases shown first. Re-submitted business at T+10 appears above first-time submission at T+1 within the same priority tier. | Must Have |
| **FR-Q.3** | Re-submission rows carry a visible attempt number badge. | Attempt number visible on queue row. First-time submissions carry no badge. | Must Have |
| **FR-Q.4** | Non-taxable indicator shown on queue rows where the business declared non-taxable. | Non-taxable indicator visible on relevant queue rows. | Must Have |
| **FR-Q.5** | Ownership invitation status column shows one of four states: Self-declared Owner (registrant declared company ownership \- no invitation sent), Accepted, Pending with days elapsed since sent, Not sent. | Self-declared Owner shown where registrant declared company ownership. Accepted shown in green. Pending shown with elapsed days. Not sent shown where no invitation has been issued. | Must Have |
| **FR-Q.6** | Queue shows a running total count of pending submissions at the top. | Counter updates in real time as reviews are completed. | Should Have |
| **FR-Q.7** | Bank account update cases are flagged as urgent with a distinct visual indicator. These cases are prioritised at the top of the queue to minimise the settlement freeze window for the affected business. | Urgent flag visible on queue row. Urgent cases appear above re-submissions in queue ordering. | Must Have |

# **4\. Business Review View**

The review view is the admin's workspace for a single business submission. It presents all submitted fields organised into three sections \- each with individual field-level actions and a section-level CTA that confirms section completion and triggers the tier unlock.

For non-taxable businesses, TIN and VAT fields are absent from the Section 1 review \- not present at all, not shown as empty. The admin sees a 'Non-taxable business (self-declared)' label and proceeds to approve the remaining Section 1 fields. The section-level CTA activates when all present actionable fields are approved.

When all fields in a section are approved, the section-level CTA becomes the most prominent element on screen. A prompt is shown: 'All fields approved \- click to unlock Tier X.' This ensures the admin cannot miss the confirmation step.

## **4.1 Review View Layout**

* Business summary card \- read-only header: legal name (Arabic), email, CR/UNN, attempt number, current tier status, non-taxable indicator (if applicable), ownership invitation status.

* Tier indicator \- shows which tiers are unlocked (Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Tier 3\) with clear visual state for each.

* Tab 1: Core Business Identification \- all fields from onboarding Step 2\. Full section approval and section CTA click unlocks Tier 1\.

* Tab 2 and Tab 3 render in a locked state until their prerequisite tier is confirmed.

* Tab 2: Beneficial Owners \- all fields from onboarding Step 3\. Full section approval and section CTA click completes Tier 2\.

* Tab 3: Bank Account Details \- IBAN and derived bank fields. IBAN approval and section CTA click unlocks Tier 3\.

* Submission history panel \- collapsible, shows all previous submissions with outcomes.

* Section-level CTAs at the bottom of each tab: 'Approve \[Section Name\] → Unlock \[Tier\] Access' (active when all actionable fields in the tab are approved) and 'Send Section for Correction' (active when at least one field is rejected).

## **4.2 Field-Level Review \- Action Matrix**

The table below is the authoritative reference for every field in the review view, the admin action available, which tier the approval contributes to, and the verification method.

| Field | Admin action | Tier unlocked | Verification method |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| ***Tab 1 \- Core Business Identification (section CTA click unlocks Tier 1\)*** |  |  |  |
| **CR/UNN Number** | Approve / Reject | Tier 1 | Cross-check against uploaded CR certificate. Admin MUST also cross-reference the CR number against the MoC public portal to confirm the CR is active and registered. This field requires a MoC confirmation checkbox before approval can be saved. |
| **Legal Business Name (Arabic)** | Approve / Reject | Tier 1 | Must match exactly as it appears on the CR certificate. |
| **Upload CR Certificate** | Approve / Reject | Tier 1 | Admin opens document viewer. Confirms legal name and CR number match submission. Document must be unexpired. |
| **Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN)** | Approve / Reject | Tier 1 | Verified via ZATCA portal. 10-digit number. Always present and required for all businesses regardless of taxability declaration. |
| **VAT Registration Number** | Approve / Reject | Tier 1 | 15-digit number starting and ending with 3\. Only shown when the Taxable Business toggle is On. Not shown for non-taxable businesses. |
| **Upload VAT Certificate** | Approve / Reject | Tier 1 | Admin opens document viewer. Confirms VAT number matches submission. Only shown when the Taxable Business toggle is On. |
| **Non-taxable declaration** | Display only | \- | Shown as a read-only label: 'Non-taxable business (self-declared)' when the business switched the Taxable Business toggle Off at onboarding. VAT Registration Number and VAT Certificate upload are absent. TIN remains present and must be approved. Admin approves TIN and clicks the section CTA to complete Tier 1\. |
| **Registered Address (National Address)** | Display only | \- | Not verified by admin. Shown for reference only. |
| ***Tab 2 \- Beneficial Owners (section CTA click completes Tier 2\)*** |  |  |  |
| **Full Name** | Approve / Reject | Tier 2 | Cross-check against uploaded owner ID document. Name must match exactly. When registrant declared company ownership in Step 1, this field is pre-filled from Step 1 Account Creator Details. |
| **National ID (Saudi) or Iqama Number (resident)** | Approve / Reject | Tier 2 | Cross-check against uploaded ID document. Number must match. |
| **Upload ID Copy (National ID, Passport, or Iqama)** | Approve / Reject | Tier 2 | Admin opens document viewer. Confirms document is clear, valid, unexpired, and matches name and ID number submitted. |
| **Ownership status** | Display only | \- | Read-only label: 'Self-declared owner' (registrant declared company ownership) or 'Ownership via invitation' with invitation status (Pending / Accepted). |
| ***Tab 3 \- Bank Account Details (section CTA click unlocks Tier 3\)*** |  |  |  |
| **IBAN** | Approve / Reject | Tier 3 | System performs mathematical IBAN validation (format and checksum) before the review view renders. Admin sees validation result (Valid / Invalid) next to the IBAN field. If result is Invalid, the Approve action is disabled \- admin can only reject. If result is Valid, admin cross-references the bank name derived from the IBAN against the business's declared bank name before approving. Valid result is advisory \- not a compelled approval. |
| **Bank Name** | Display only | \- | Auto-derived from IBAN. No independent admin action required. |
| **Account Holder Name** | Display only | \- | Shown for reference alongside IBAN. |
| **Bank Account Number** | Display only | \- | Shown for reference. |

Non-taxable businesses: VAT Registration Number and VAT Certificate upload are completely absent from the Section 1 review view \- not shown as empty or greyed out. TIN is present and must be approved. The admin approves all Section 1 fields including TIN and clicks the section CTA. Tier 1 unlocks normally.

The admin interface surfaces ownership invitation status for each business. This is informational for all admin roles \- no admin role can resend, cancel, or modify an ownership invitation from the admin interface. That action belongs to the merchant's Admin role in business settings. Four states are possible: Self-declared Owner, Accepted, Pending, Not sent.

| FR ID | Requirement | Acceptance Criteria | Priority |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **FR-O.1** | The review view and the all-businesses directory both show ownership invitation status per business: Self-declared Owner (registrant declared company ownership \- no invitation sent), Accepted, Pending (with days elapsed), or Not sent. | Ownership invitation status visible in both the review view and all-businesses directory for all admin roles. Read-only for all roles \- no action available. | Must Have |
| **FR-O.2** | The pending verification queue shows a flag on businesses where the ownership invitation has been outstanding for more than 7 days. Informational only \- does not affect queue ordering. | Queue row shows an indicator for invitations older than 7 days. | Should Have |
| **FR-O.3** | All admin roles can view ownership invitation status in read-only mode. No admin role has action buttons available on ownership invitation status. | Ownership invitation status visible to all admin roles in read-only view. No action buttons available for any role. | Must Have |

| **FR-D.2** | The directory is filterable by tier status and searchable by business name (Arabic) or CR/UNN number. | Filters and search apply in real time. All filter combinations supported. | Must Have |

Finance/Settlement and Risk & Compliance see only their role-relevant fields. Super Admin and Operations see all fields. | Must Have |

# **7\. Ops Process Requirements**

This section defines the operational cases that the Qawafel Operations team manages on the APEX admin interface. The bank account update case is surfaced in the Pending Queue as it is directly tied to the verification tier and must be actioned immediately to lift the settlement freeze.

## **7.1 Admin Interface Navigation**

| Tab | Purpose & Cases |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Pending Queue** | Primary working view for verification review. Contains all businesses with status Pending Verification or Action Required. Also surfaces bank account update post-Tier 3 cases as urgent flagged rows \- these are tier-dependent and must be actioned immediately to lift the settlement freeze. |
| **All Businesses** | Complete registered business registry. Used for look-up, audit, and profile review. Role-based field visibility enforced. |

## **7.2 Case Definition & Resolution Flow**

| Case 1 \- Bank Account Update Post-Tier 3  (Location: Pending Queue \- urgent flagged row) |  |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Trigger** | A Tier 3 business submits a new IBAN. Tier 3 is immediately suspended on submission. Settlement freeze begins. |
| **What ops sees** | Urgent-flagged row in the Pending Queue. Review view shows the new IBAN submission with mathematical validation result displayed. |
| **Resolution steps** | 1\. Open the urgent case from the top of the Pending Queue.2. Review the new IBAN using the mathematical validation result displayed in the review view.3. If Invalid: Approve is disabled \- reject and notify the business.4. If Valid: cross-reference the bank name derived from the IBAN against the business's declared bank name.5. Approve or reject based on the cross-reference.6. Tier 3 reinstates immediately on approval. Settlement freeze lifted. Business notified. |
| **Outcomes** | Approved \- Tier 3 reinstated, settlement payouts resume. Rejected \- business must resubmit a corrected IBAN. |
| **SLA** | No fixed SLA \- priority queue position is the mechanism to minimise the settlement freeze window. |

## **7.3 Ops Process \- Functional Requirements**

| FR ID | Requirement | Acceptance Criteria | Priority |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **OP-1** | Bank account update post-Tier 3: when a Tier 3 business submits a new IBAN, the case is flagged as urgent in the Pending Queue and the settlement freeze begins immediately. | Urgent flag on Pending Queue row. Admin reviews new IBAN using mathematical validation and bank name cross-reference. If Invalid, Approve disabled. Settlement freeze shown on business dashboard. Tier 3 reinstated immediately on IBAN approval. Business notified. | Must Have |
