# 14 \- Credit Note List View

**Credit Note List View**

| Related documents: Document 12 (Credit Note Creation), Document 13 (Credit Note Submission & Lifecycle), Document 10 (Invoice List View) \- invoices link here when a related credit note exists. |
| :---- |

# **Purpose**

This document describes the screen a business user lands on to view, search, and review their credit notes. Credit notes have their own dedicated list, separate from the invoice list, so a business user can find all of their credit notes in one place without expanding each invoice individually.

# **Columns**

| Column | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Credit note reference number | The credit note's own reference number, using its distinct prefix. Selecting it opens the credit note. |
| Date | The credit note's date. |
| Business Partner | The trading partner the credit note relates to \- always the same buying business as the original invoice. |
| Reason | The reason selected when the credit note was created. |
| Status | Draft, Sent to ZATCA, Cleared, or Rejected. |
| Amount | The total credited amount. |
| Linked invoice | The reference number of the original invoice this credit note corrects, shown as a clickable link to that invoice. |

# **Search**

Search covers the credit note reference number, the business partner name, and the linked invoice reference number.

# **Default sort order**

Credit notes are sorted by date, most recent first. A business can re-sort by selecting the date or amount column heading.

# **Filters**

A business user can filter the list to one of the following at a time:

| All  ·  Draft  ·  Sent to ZATCA  ·  Cleared  ·  Rejected |
| :---- |

# **Actions available directly from the list**

| Status | Available actions |
| :---- | :---- |
| Draft | Edit, Delete. |
| Sent to ZATCA | None. |
| Cleared | Download. |
| Rejected | None \- a new credit note is created separately, from the original invoice, if still needed. |

# **Link from the invoice list**

Any invoice with one or more credit notes shows an indicator on the invoice list (Document 10\) and on its own detail view (Document 11), linking back to this list filtered to that invoice's related credit notes.

# **Empty states**

* No credit notes at all: the business is shown a short explanatory message \- a business with no Cleared invoices yet, or one that has never needed to correct an invoice, will see this.

* A filter or search returns no matching credit notes: a message indicates no matches were found, with an option to clear the filter or search.

# **Functional Requirements**

Each requirement below is independently testable and maps to a single piece of buildable work.

| ID | Requirement | Acceptance criteria |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| FR-14.1 | Every credit note, regardless of status, appears in this dedicated list, separate from the invoice list. | Credit notes are not shown as rows within the invoice list; they only appear in this list. |
| FR-14.2 | Each credit note row displays a link to its original invoice. | Selecting the linked invoice reference number on a credit note row navigates to that invoice's detail view. |
| FR-14.3 | Search matches against credit note reference number, buyer name, and linked invoice reference number. | Entering a search term returns credit notes where the term appears in any of these three fields. |
| FR-14.4 | The list is sorted by date, most recent first, by default. | On first load, the most recently dated credit note appears at the top of the list. |
| FR-14.5 | A business can filter the list to exactly one of the defined status values at a time. | Selecting a filter shows only credit notes matching that single status. |
| FR-14.6 | Row-level actions shown match exactly the action set defined for that credit note's status. | A Draft credit note's row offers only Edit and Delete. A Cleared credit note's row offers only Download. |
| FR-14.7 | An invoice with at least one related credit note displays an indicator on the invoice list and detail view linking to this list, filtered to that invoice. | Selecting the credit note indicator on an invoice opens this list pre-filtered to show only credit notes related to that invoice. |
| FR-14.8 | An empty credit note list and a filtered or searched list with no results each display a distinct, clear message. | Each of these scenarios shows wording specific to that scenario, not a single generic empty message. |

## 

## **Story Pack**

## **CN-14-US01 \- View the Dedicated Credit Note List**

**User Story**  
As an authorised Business User, I want all credit notes in a dedicated list so that I can review corrections separately from invoices.

**Acceptance Criteria**

* Every Business credit note appears in the Credit Note list regardless of status.  
* Credit notes are not displayed as invoice rows in the Invoice list.  
* Each row shows credit note reference number, date, Business Partner, reason, lifecycle status, credited amount, and linked invoice reference.  
* Selecting the credit note reference opens the Credit Note detail view.  
* The Business Partner is the buyer from the original invoice.  
* The linked invoice reference is clickable.  
* Only credit notes belonging to the Current Business are shown.

---

## **CN-14-US02 \- Search Credit Notes**

**User Story**  
As an authorised Business User, I want to search credit notes so that I can find a correction by its own reference, buyer, or original invoice.

**Acceptance Criteria**

* Search matches the credit note reference number.  
* Search matches the Business Partner or buyer name.  
* Search matches the linked original invoice reference number.  
* A term matching any supported field returns the credit note.  
* Search includes credit notes in all lifecycle statuses.  
* A no-results message identifies that no credit notes match the search.  
* The user can clear the search.

---

## **CN-14-US03 \- Sort and Filter Credit Notes**

**User Story**  
As an authorised Business User, I want to sort and filter credit notes so that I can focus on the relevant corrections.

**Acceptance Criteria**

* The default sort is credit note date, most recent first.  
* The user can re-sort by date.  
* The user can re-sort by credited amount.  
* The available filters are All, Draft, Sent to ZATCA, Cleared, and Rejected.  
* Only one filter can be active at a time.  
* Sorting preserves the current search and filter.  
* A filter with no matches displays a filter-specific message.  
* The user can clear the active filter.

---

## **CN-14-US04 \- Use Status-Specific Credit Note Row Actions**

**User Story**  
As an authorised Business User, I want credit note row actions limited by status so that I cannot perform an invalid operation.

**Acceptance Criteria**

* Draft rows offer Edit and Delete only.  
* Sent to ZATCA rows offer no action.  
* Cleared rows offer Download only.  
* Rejected rows offer no action.  
* A new credit note for a rejected correction must be started separately from the original invoice.  
* No bulk action can change multiple credit notes at once unless introduced by another approved PRD.  
* Direct requests cannot perform an action unavailable for the current status.

---

## **CN-14-US05 \- Navigate Between Invoices and Related Credit Notes**

**User Story**  
As an authorised Business User, I want to navigate between an invoice and its credit notes so that I can review the complete correction history.

**Acceptance Criteria**

* Every credit note row displays a clickable link to its original invoice.  
* Selecting the invoice link opens that Invoice detail view.  
* An invoice with one or more credit notes displays an indicator in its list and detail views.  
* Selecting the invoice's indicator opens the Credit Note list pre-filtered to that invoice.  
* The pre-filtered list shows only credit notes related to the selected invoice.  
* Clearing the relationship filter returns to the full Credit Note list.

---

## **CN-14-US06 \- View Credit Note List Empty States**

**User Story**  
As an authorised Business User, I want clear credit note empty states so that I understand whether no corrections exist or my search has no matches.

**Acceptance Criteria**

* A Business with no credit notes sees an explanatory initial empty state.  
* The message is suitable for a Business with no Cleared invoices or one that has never needed a correction.  
* A search with no results shows a search-specific message.  
* A filter with no results shows a filter-specific message.  
* Search and filter no-results states provide a way to clear the active condition.  
* The initial empty state is not shown when records exist but are hidden by search or filter.

---

# 15 \- Credit Note Detail View & Status Lifecycle

**Credit Note Detail View & Status Lifecycle**

| Related documents: This document is the single source of truth for credit note status and the full action matrix. Document 12 (Credit Note Creation), Document 13 (Credit Note Submission & Lifecycle), Document 14 (Credit Note List View), Document 11 (Invoice Detail View & Status Lifecycle) \- for the equivalent invoice reference. |
| :---- |

# **Purpose**

This document describes what a business user sees when they open a single credit note, and brings together every status a credit note can carry and every action available at each one. Where this document and any other document in this set differ on a credit note status or action, this document is the authoritative source.

# **What appears on every credit note**

The credit note detail view shows the complete credit note \- selling business details, buying business details, date, the reason, the credited line items, the VAT breakdown, the summary totals, and notes. Alongside this, the detail view shows:

* The credit note's current lifecycle status.

* A link to the original invoice this credit note corrects.

* Which channel brought the original invoice into APEX \- this context is visible so the business user understands the relationship between the credit note and its source.

* A full history of what has happened to this credit note \- when it was created, submitted, and cleared or rejected.

# **Lifecycle statuses \- full definition**

| Status | Meaning |
| :---- | :---- |
| Draft | Being built inside APEX. Not yet submitted to ZATCA. Can be edited or deleted. |
| Sent to ZATCA | Submitted. Identifiers locked. Awaiting a response from ZATCA. |
| Cleared | Accepted by ZATCA. Legally effective. The original invoice's outstanding balance is automatically recalculated. Can never be edited or deleted. |
| Rejected | Not accepted by ZATCA. Permanent record. Identifiers can never be reused. No resubmission \- a new credit note must be created from the original invoice if still needed. |

# **Full action matrix \- every status, every available action**

| Status | Available actions |
| :---- | :---- |
| Draft | Edit, Delete, Submit for ZATCA clearance. |
| Sent to ZATCA | None \- view only. |
| Cleared | Download the credit note document. |
| Rejected | None \- view only. A new credit note is created separately from the original invoice if still needed. |

# **What is never possible, on any credit note, at any status**

* Editing a Cleared credit note.

* Deleting a Cleared, Sent to ZATCA, or Rejected credit note.

* Reverting a Sent to ZATCA, Cleared, or Rejected credit note back to Draft.

* Resubmitting a Rejected credit note \- a new credit note must always be created instead.

# **Link to the original invoice**

Every credit note detail view displays the reference number of the original invoice it corrects, as a clickable link that opens that invoice's detail view. This link is always present regardless of the credit note's status.

# **Record keeping**

Every credit note, regardless of its final status, is retained permanently once it leaves Draft. This includes Rejected credit notes. No business user can permanently delete a credit note once it has left Draft status, in line with the same six-year retention requirement that applies to invoices.

# **Functional Requirements**

Each requirement below is independently testable and maps to a single piece of buildable work.

| ID | Requirement | Acceptance criteria |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| FR-15.1 | The credit note detail view displays the lifecycle status, a link to the original invoice, the originating channel of the original invoice, and a full history of status changes. | Opening any credit note shows all four of these elements in the detail view. |
| FR-15.2 | The available actions shown on a credit note detail view exactly match the action matrix defined in this document for that credit note's current status. | A Draft credit note's detail view offers Edit, Delete, and Submit only. A Cleared credit note's detail view offers Download only, with no edit or delete option present anywhere on the screen. |
| FR-15.3 | There is no edit option available on any credit note with lifecycle status Sent to ZATCA, Cleared, or Rejected. | No edit control is available on a credit note in any of these statuses. |
| FR-15.4 | There is no delete option available on any credit note with lifecycle status Sent to ZATCA, Cleared, or Rejected. | No delete control is available on a credit note in any of these statuses. |
| FR-15.5 | There is no resubmit action on a Rejected credit note. | No submit or resubmit control exists on a Rejected credit note's detail view. |
| FR-15.6 | Every credit note detail view displays a clickable link to its original invoice, regardless of status. | Selecting the linked invoice reference number navigates to that invoice's detail view. |
| FR-15.7 | A Cleared credit note can be downloaded by the business user as a document. | A download control is available on a Cleared credit note and produces the credit note document. |
| FR-15.8 | A credit note is never permanently deleted once it has left Draft status, regardless of its final outcome. | A Rejected credit note remains permanently accessible and is never removed from the business's records. |
| FR-15.9 | The credit note detail view shows a complete history of status changes, including timestamps. | A business user can view when the credit note was created, submitted, and cleared or rejected, in chronological order. |

## **Story Pack**

## **CN-15-US01 \- View Complete Credit Note Details and History**

**User Story**  
As an authorised Business User, I want to open a credit note and see its complete details and history so that I can understand the correction and its outcome.

**Acceptance Criteria**

* The detail view displays selling Business details and buying Business details.  
* It displays the credit note date and selected reason.  
* It displays credited line items, VAT breakdown, summary totals, and notes.  
* It displays the current lifecycle status.  
* It displays a link to the original invoice.  
* It displays the channel through which the original invoice entered APEX.  
* It shows when the credit note was created, submitted, and Cleared or Rejected as applicable.  
* Every history entry includes a timestamp and is ordered chronologically.  
* Repeated processing of the same event does not create duplicate history entries.

---

## **CN-15-US02 \- Apply the Credit Note Lifecycle and Action Matrix**

**User Story**  
As an authorised Business User, I want credit note statuses and actions applied consistently so that I know exactly what can be done at each stage.

**Acceptance Criteria**

* Draft means the credit note is being built and may be edited, deleted, or submitted.  
* Sent to ZATCA means identifiers are locked and the credit note is view-only while awaiting response.  
* Cleared means the credit note is legally effective, the original invoice balance has been recalculated, and the credit note is immutable.  
* Rejected means the credit note is a permanent failed record and cannot be resubmitted.  
* Draft offers Edit, Delete, and Submit.  
* Sent to ZATCA offers no action.  
* Cleared offers Download only.  
* Rejected offers no action.  
* The same labels and actions are used consistently in the Credit Note list and detail view.

---

## **CN-15-US03 \- Prevent Invalid Credit Note Changes**

**User Story**  
As a Business, I want submitted credit notes protected from invalid changes so that legal correction records remain trustworthy.

**Acceptance Criteria**

* No edit option is available for Sent to ZATCA, Cleared, or Rejected credit notes.  
* No delete option is available for Sent to ZATCA, Cleared, or Rejected credit notes.  
* No submitted credit note can be reverted to Draft.  
* No Rejected credit note has a submit or resubmit action.  
* A replacement correction must be created as a new credit note from the original invoice.  
* Restrictions are enforced beyond visible controls and cannot be bypassed through direct requests.

---

## **CN-15-US04 \- Open the Original Invoice from a Credit Note**

**User Story**  
As an authorised Business User, I want a permanent link to the original invoice so that I can move directly from the correction to the document it changes.

**Acceptance Criteria**

* Every Credit Note detail view displays the original invoice reference number.  
* The reference number is a clickable link.  
* The link is present in Draft, Sent to ZATCA, Cleared, and Rejected statuses.  
* Selecting the link opens the correct Invoice detail view.  
* The link cannot resolve an invoice belonging to another Business.  
* The relationship remains available for retained Rejected credit notes.

---

## **CN-15-US05 \- Download and Retain Final Credit Note Records**

**User Story**  
As an authorised Business User, I want final credit note records downloadable and permanently retained so that the Business can satisfy legal and audit needs.

**Acceptance Criteria**

* A Cleared credit note provides a Download action.  
* The downloaded document contains the final locked credit note data.  
* A credit note cannot be permanently deleted after it leaves Draft.  
* Rejected credit notes remain permanently accessible.  
* Cleared and Sent to ZATCA credit notes remain permanently accessible.  
* Business User permissions cannot override the retention rule.  
* Retention preserves the original invoice relationship and lifecycle history.

# 16 \- Invoice Sharing

**Draft: 16 \- Send Invoice Inside Qawafel**

# 

**Message from Qays which is aligned with Hegazy and Gorav.**

*1\. One action, multiple channels*

*"Send Invoice" will be a single action with multiple channel options: send inside Qawafel*, or send via external channels such as *Email, WhatsApp, etc.* Everything below covers the *send inside Qawafel* option only. Eternal channels will be specified separately.

*2\. Default behavior — nothing is sent*

*By default, an invoice created by the seller is NOT* visible to or sent to the buyer inside Qawafel. Nothing changes from current behavior unless the seller acts.

*3\. Sending inside Qawafel*

* *When the seller selects the inside-Qawafel option, the buyer receives notifications* and sees the invoice under a new tab called *Received Invoices*.  
* Only *Qawafel-generated* invoices can be sent inside Qawafel. Other channels (Email, WhatsApp, etc.) will be available for all invoice types.  
* Only *Cleared* invoices can be sent inside Qawafel.  
* Sending inside Qawafel is *irreversible*. Once sent, the action cannot be reverted.

*4\. Auto-send setting*

*A global setting will allow automatic sending inside Qawafel of invoices. off by default*.

*5\. Payment*

*At this stage, paying an invoice is available through the payment link only*. In the future, we can add a payment option directly in Received Invoices.

*6\. Beyond invoices*

*The same model applies to other documents we may introduce later (POs, proposals, etc.).*
